## Share transfer agreement: notice particulars

The parties to this agreement are:

- ⟦PERSON|Nóra O'Mellane⟧ (the 'Seller');
- ⟦ORG|Clover Quoin Holdings Ltd⟧ (the 'Buyer').

The seller agrees to deliver the signed transfer and the original share certificate at completion. The buyer must provide the agreed consideration of EUR 14,800 through the payment arrangement confirmed separately. A copy of a transfer supplied for review does not authorise an alteration to the original after signature.

Notices to the seller are to be sent to ⟦ADDRESS|17 Bracken Vale, Cork⟧. The buyer's United States correspondence address is ⟦ADDRESS|Suite 704, 62 Kestrel Avenue, Boston, MA 02110-4826⟧. Each address is supplied as a single line, with commas separating its components. The four digits after the hyphen form part of the second address's postal code.

The parties must preserve evidence that a notice was sent to the correct destination. Dispatch to an earlier address is insufficient after receipt of a signed change-of-address instruction. A request to change bank details is outside the notice mechanism in this clause and requires separate verification.

The completion appointment is proposed for 6 January 2027. Section 7.3 governs delivery of the supporting documents and does not permit waiver of a missing certificate by silence.

Signed: ⟦PERSON|Nóra O'Mellane⟧.

For the buyer: ⟦PERSON|Łukasz McQuill⟧, authorised signatory.
